description: Guard rails for the local OpenCode agent worker. Read by src/lib/agent-policy.ts (dashboard API) and scripts/agent-worker.mjs (executor) so both enforce the same rules. A job whose instructions match a rule is held for approval; a job that runs a shell command matching a rule is stopped and marked failed.

blockedModels.reason: The 7B model needs about 4.2 GB of RAM and exhausted the 8 GB VPS on 2026-10-24, making SSH and the dashboard unresponsive. Local worker jobs use ollama/qwen2.5-coder:3b instead.

dangerPatterns.reason: Deleting a remote branch removes work other people may depend on.
Dropping or truncating database objects destroys data.
Recursive deletion of a drive root or home directory is irreversible.
Repository deletion is irreversible and needs explicit approval.
Infrastructure creation and destruction changes live, billable systems.
DNS and nameserver changes can take live sites offline.
Creating or increasing spending needs explicit approval.
